name: Juliana Republic (1839)
description: A horizontal tricolour of green, white and yellow.
history: The Juliana Republic was proclaimed at Laguna, Santa Catarina, on 29 July 1839 by the Farrapos rebels under Giuseppe Garibaldi and David Canabarro. Its tricolour was created on 10 August and adopted on 10 September 1839; imperial forces retook Laguna on 15 November 1839 and the republic collapsed.
